    st.name AS territory_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM soh.orderdate) AS year,
    SUM(soh.totaldue) AS revenue
  FROM sales.salesorderheader soh
  JOIN sales.salesterritory st ON soh.territoryid = st.territoryid
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM soh.orderdate) IN (2023, 2024)
  GROUP BY st.territoryid, st.name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM soh.orderdate)
)
SELECT
  r2024.territory_name,
  r2024.revenue AS revenue_2024,
  r2023.revenue AS revenue_2023,
  (r2024.revenue - r2023.revenue) AS revenue_increase
FROM revenue_by_year r2024
JOIN revenue_by_year r2023
  ON r2024.territoryid = r2023.territoryid
  AND r2024.year = 2024
  AND r2023.year = 2023
ORDER BY revenue_increase DESC
